expansionRule: Every logical case executes once in each of the three declared Playwright engines. Loops inside a case are assertions within one observation, not additional observations.
historicalComparisonPolicy: Historical material may support only equivalent Professional/shared lineage. It cannot substitute for a current observation or turn removed Application observations into current scope.
safeFallbackPolicy: SAFE_FALLBACK is an occurrence attribute, never a failure class. A safe whole-story vertical fallback can pass when it is the contractually expected capacity result.
collectionPolicy: Persist each engine/group JSON result, classify every unique failing root cause, and continue through the locked matrix. One bounded harness correction and one retry are allowed only when the validation pipeline itself blocks collection.
